_source: GitHub /repos API, captured 2026-10-02 for tests (offline); openvinotoolkit/openvino captured 2026-10-24

0xbakeer/tandemllm.description: An environment where open models work as agents: a first-level harness with routing, skills, memory and sandboxed tools, on an engine that drafts and verifies its own tokens.

ashhart/tensorfold.description: Fast, exact LLM decoding on Apple Silicon (MLX) behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

carloslfu/slotstream.description: Run a 105 GB AI model on a Mac that can't hold it. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 4-bit, streamed from SSD on 16–64 GB Apple Silicon Macs. Fully native Swift, MLX and Metal. Offline, no Python. CLI, Swift library, and Ollama/OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Works with Claude Code and Codex.

carouselaether/rocm_exl3.description: A fork of exllamav3 for ROCm.

daig/omlx-exl3.description: EXL3 (ExLlamaV3) quantized models on Apple Silicon with oMLX: Metal kernels; Qwen3.8-27B at MLX 8-bit quality in 6 bits, 2.3x faster with MTP

ddalcu/mlx-serve.description: Native LLM inference server for Apple Silicon. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. No Python. Zig backend, Swift frontend macOS app with chat, music, voice, video generation.

deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.

drumih/turbo-fieldfare.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B inference in ~2 GB of RAM on any M-series MacBook

flashml-org/freetoken.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.

geramy/lse.description: HRX, LOOM, Mac, and AMD running top speed kernels with a self optimizing engine.

google-ai-edge/litert.description: LiteRT, successor to TensorFlow Lite. is Google's On-device framework for high-performance ML & GenAI deployment on edge platforms, via efficient conversion, runtime, and optimization

haddard/llama.cpp.description: llama.cpp – Adaptive Speculation + Fastest Vulkan on AMD Strix Halo

hardenedlinux/sonicboom.description: A compiler-first PyTorch alternative. MLIR-based Boom IR, Guile scripting, CUDA and CPU. On consumer GPUs it already beats llama.cpp’s LLM decode with the same kernels; the compiler makes the difference. GPLv3.

hikicoder/llama.cpp.description: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash expert streaming on a ~20 GB GPU: faster prefill for JigSawPT's dsv41-porte branch (fork of JigSawPT/llama.cpp). See README-dsv41.md.

jakeatx/llamampere.description: llama.cpp fork for significantly improved performance on Ampere (especially RTX 3090 / 3090 Ti): example: 95+ tok/s over a 100K-token generation at temperature 1 for qwen3.8, supporting full 262K ctx.

jundot/omlx.description: LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching for Apple Silicon — managed from the macOS menu bar

l-forster/open-jet.description: An offline coding agent for local models. One command sets up the best model your GPU can run, and on 24 GB+ RTX 30/40/50-series cards Qwen3.8-27B runs up to 1.9x faster than llama.cpp.

laurentzuijdwijk/llama.cpp.description: llama.cpp with adaptive speculative decoding (--spec-draft-adaptive) and a Vulkan backend tuned for AMD Strix Halo. 4.7x on structured output, 1.9x mainline prefill on MoE.

layr-labs/mlxfast-bonsai2-27b-engine.description: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B MLX inference speedup benchmark engine

leeex1/quillan.cpp.description: quillan.cpp is a high-performance, lightweight, standalone C++17 inference engine engineered for the Quillan-Ronin sovereign multi-tier cognitive architecture.  Inspired by the minimalistic philosophies of llama.cpp and bitnet.cpp, quillan.cpp operates with zero heavyweight runtime dependencies (no PyTorch, no LibTorch, no Python runtime), running

lightseekorg/tokenspeed.description: TokenSpeed is a speed-of-light LLM inference engine.

magnitudedev/magnitude.description: Open source inference engine that tunes its kernels on your hardware to find the fastest way to run each model. 2x faster than Ollama. Works on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, or just a CPU.

ml-explore/mlx.description: MLX: An array framework for Apple silicon

mw00/project-maya.description: Project Maya - GLM-5.3-Flash (321B MoE) on your own NVIDIA GPU(s): engine, server, dashboard, quant tools. Built on Strata.

nace-ai/kapitsa.description: Blazing fast Apple Silicon optimized inference engine built for Qwen, Nemotron & Flint. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. Built by folks from nace.ai

niko1221/strata.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on any consumer hardware: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.

nvidia/tensorrt-llm.description: TensorRT LLM provides users with an easy-to-use Python API to define Large Language Models (LLMs) and supports state-of-the-art optimizations to perform inference efficiently on NVIDIA GPUs. TensorRT LLM also contains components to create Python and C++ runtimes that orchestrate the inference execution in a performant way.

ollama/ollama.description: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.

open-webui/open-webui.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)

openvinotoolkit/openvino.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference

perkel666/megacapybara.description: The fastest inference engine for Qwen3.8-27B on the NVIDIA RTX 5090: up to 500 tokens/s for one agent and up to 2,000 tokens/s for many, contexts up to 1M tokens, and a launcher that shows what every setting costs. Windows and Linux.

prabanta-dev/janas.description: 37 tok/s from Qwen3-Next-80B (48 GB) on a 32 GB laptop, 24 without drafts vs 2.8 for llama.cpp; reading 62 vs 16 tok/s. Faster than llama.cpp on all 13 models compared in Q4_K_M. LLMs bigger than your RAM, pure C, CPU or GPU.

pytorch/pytorch.description: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

raullenchai/rapid-mlx.description: Rapid-MLX is an open-source (Apache 2.0) OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM inference server for Apple Silicon, built on MLX, focused on reliable tool calling for coding agents. Up to 4× faster than Apple's MLX (mlx-lm) on the same weights.

sgl-project/sglang.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language models and multimodal models.

shawnshekari/strixite.description: LLM inference engine written from scratch in HIP for AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - ~50 tokens/s out to 492k context

sybil-solutions/glm-flash-lite.description: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 on one 24 GB RTX 3090 + DDR4: elastic GPU expert cache, zero-copy experts, AVX2 CPU tier, OpenAI API

turboderp-org/exllamav3.description: An optimized quantization and inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer-class GPUs

vllm-project/vllm.description: A high-throughput and memory-efficient inference and serving engine for LLMs

youssofal/mtplx.description: The fastest way to run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, Qwen 3.8 27B and Ternary Bonsai 2 27B on a Mac: 125 tok/s in OpenCode on an M5 Max, and a 27B model on 16 GB Macs. Native MTP speculative decoding on Apple Silicon, exact at any temperature. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible local server.

z-lab/dflash.description: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
